job.title: Process Operators - Fixed Plant
job.description:

job.title: Boilermaker
job.description:

job.title: Maintenance Electrician / Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
• Permanent Roles or Temp to commence
  • Multiple Opportunities
  • A-Grade Electrician | Mechanical Fitter – Fixed Plant
  • Day / Night / Weekends Rotating Shift Roster
  • Excellent Competitive Pay Rates + Allowances
About the Roles

Our Client, a Harvey based premium meat processing facility are seeking the professional services of trade qualified:
  1. A-Grade Electricians
  2. Mechanical Fitters
Responsible for maintaining meat processing fixed plant and associated equipment, responding to breakdowns and supporting initiatives to maximise plant availability for quality meat production.
  1. A-Grade Electrician Accountabilities:
  • Ensure compliance with AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules and relevant electrical standards
  • Complete daily, weekly, and monthly planned work orders through the MEX maintenance management system
  • Maintain the integrity and reliability of site electrical installations and equipment
  • Respond to electrical breakdowns during production to minimise downtime
  • Diagnose faults and undertake programming of PLCs, variable speed drives, MCCs and control systems
  • Analyse equipment failures and implement preventative measures to reduce recurring issues
  • Assist with electrical repairs, upgrades, shutdowns, and capital projects.
  1. Mechanical Fitter Accountabilities:
  • Perform maintenance and repairs on plant and production equipment
  • Complete daily, weekly and monthly planned work orders through the MEX maintenance system to ensure plant reliability and support production targets
  • Respond to mechanical breakdowns and perform timely fault diagnosis and repair
  • Troubleshoot equipment failures and process-related issues
  • Support preventative and predictive maintenance programs
  • Assemble and fit machined parts using precision fitting techniques
  • Drill, tap, machine and modify components, check tolerances clearances, alignment and operation of moving part – as required
  • Cut, thread, bend and install hydraulic and pneumatic pipes and lines.
Essential Requirements
  • Relevant trade qualification is essential
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Excellent fitting and fault-finding skills with experience in industrial maintenance environments
  • Strong PLC fault-finding and programming experience with sound knowledge of motors, drives, MCCs and industrial control systems
  • Ability to read and interpret relevant engineering drawings and pneumatic schematics
  • Machining experience including milling, turning and general workshop machining
  • Fabrication and welding experience in mild steel and stainless steel
  • A good understanding of Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) regulations, food processing, or meat industry (preferred but not essential)
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality and teamwork.

job.title: Supervisor - Food Services
job.description:
South West Personnel (SWP) are seeking an experienced Food Services Supervisor to support the Food Services Coordinator and Kitchen Supervisors within a busy hospital kitchen in Bunbury.

With a commitment to outstanding customer service and patient care, this role will support food service operations across the hospital's food services, onsite café and kitchen environments, offering a variety of shifts and work settings.

Duties Can Include:
  • Coordinating the team across day and afternoon shifts to ensure the smooth running of food service operations
  • Understanding rostering requirements within a seven-day-a-week operation, including staffing levels, shift coverage and managing changes or absences as they arise
  • Leading, supporting, mentoring and developing staff, including coordinating training and ensuring team members are competent and confident in their duties
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of HACCP and food safety requirements
  • Maintaining a strong focus on workplace health and safety, including identifying hazards, completing incident and safety reporting, and following up on areas of concern
  • Ensuring appropriate standards of hygiene, infection control, cleaning and food service are consistently maintained
  • Managing day-to-day staffing and operational issues, including addressing performance or workplace matters appropriately, while working closely with the Food Services Coordinator to maintain an efficient, safe and well-organised department
  • Backfilling the Food Services Coordinator position during annual leave, personal leave or other absences
To Be Successful, You Will Bring:
  • Previous supervisory experience within catering, hospitality, food service or healthcare
  • Previous experience within hospitality and commercial cleaning environments, with a strong understanding of cleanliness, hygiene and presentation standards
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to motivate, coach and develop a diverse team
  • A thorough understanding of food safety and hygiene requirements
  • Confidence using computer systems and completing compliance documentation
  • Flexibility to work across the operational roster, including weekends if required
